people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: He built an altar there, and called on Yahweh’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.
translations.bsb: So Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the LORD, and he pitched his tent there. His servants also dug a well there.
translations.kjv: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.
translations.asv: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of Jehovah, and pitched his tent there. And there Isaac's servants digged a well.
